To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) stakeholders are important to the success or failure of IS projects; (ii) stakeholder management is a key factor for successful IS projects; (iii) the stakeholder analysis framework can be applied to IS project abandonment research; and (iv) the stakeholder theory is useful in explaining the reasons for project abandonment.

the stakeholders’ perception of the importance of IS projects, their expectations of the IS development project, and their perception of their own influence on the IS development project all influence the IS development project’s abandonment decision.

stakeholders’ roles and expectations in IS project abandonment can be organized into three categories (i.e. project, organizational and personal) based on their contributions to the project, the organization and their personal benefits.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the abandonment of IS development projects and how to manage the stakeholders in such projects.
the identification of the stakeholders’ roles and their interrelationships in influencing the decision to abandon an IS development project.
the role of the project stakeholders and their contribution to IS project abandonment.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this study has contributed to the understanding of the stakeholder perspective in the context of IS project abandonment.
the abandonment of IS development projects is not only a technical or financial decision, but also a stakeholder-related decision.
a stakeholder analysis is useful to understand the reasons for project abandonment and how the project abandonment can be avoided or reduced.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a stakeholder analysis is a useful tool to examine the roles and contribution of stakeholders in influencing organizational decision to abandon IS projects.
a better understanding of project stakeholders is required in order to manage the project abandonment process.
the abandonment of an IS development project is the result of an interplay between the project stakeholders and the organizational context in which they operate.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the project abandonment review model can be used as a tool for practitioners to assess the project abandonment situation.
the abandonment of IS projects should not only be seen as a technical problem, but as a complex problem that involves a range of factors.
the abandonment decision is influenced by stakeholders’ perceptions and expectations.
